verdict.rationale: Neon's own docs show branch lifecycle automation that can run from CI. neon.ts declares per-branch policy, including TTLs for auto-expiring branches, and its plan/apply logic can be called from a CI job. Auth docs also reference preview and CI branches. However, the pack never documents an explicit per-pull-request create-on-open / delete-on-close workflow; the GitHub integration appears only as a page title. Missing for 10: documented per-PR branch creation and teardown triggered by PR events, deploy-platform (e.g. Vercel preview) integration details, and hands-on or independent corroboration of CI branch automation.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can create and tear down per-pull-request database branches automatically from CI or my deploy platform

citations.quote: To call the same `inspect` / `plan` / `apply` logic from your own script or CI job instead of the CLI, see `@neon/config-runtime`.
